profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Full stack software engineer passionate about building scalable applications and developer tools utilizing Javascript, React, Node/Express and designing SQL/NoSQL databases.

Embedded software developer (C) for the last 4 years, developing features for Stratix 10/Agilex FPGA's and supporting unit/hardware level tests.

Co-creator of obServerJS, an open-source Express server debugging and testing application.

Recently presented a talk as part of SingleSprout's Tech Talk Series: "Javascript Metaprogramming and Quirks".

Check out my projects and open source contributions:
github.com/e-wilding

positions.title: Firmware Engineer
positions.description:
• Responsible for feature development, testing, and maintenance of Stratix 10 and Agilex FPGA configuration firmware developed in C which requires processing, analyzing, and authenticating incoming bitstreams via JTAG, AVST, or QSPI interfaces to program FPGA designs or applications.

• Created an ASIC emulation prototyping feature that enabled ASIC emulation designs to communicate with the FPGA Local Sector Manager’s (LSM) firmware via GPIO handshaking protocol to read and write to user registers of LSM memory to enable the storage of emulation design data.

• Implemented an FPGA bitstream security feature that prevented the manipulation or tampering of bitstreams to protect against security breaches, firmware manipulation, or unauthorized access of design programming on certain FPGA devices.

• Utilized Google Test to develop and maintain unit tests to isolate and test functions, basic logic flows, and input/output validation to catch bugs early in development and ultimately protect against security attacks.

• Designed block/hardware level tests to validate new security features by isolating relevant APIs to ensure proper SHA, DMA, and other hardware component initializations and functional flows.

positions.title: Validation Engineer
positions.description:
Debug Tool Team

• Enabled and supported python based debug tools for new SOC/server products to allow JTAG interfacing into the device for full processor and sub-component register status and other device property information.

positions.title: Validation Engineer
positions.description:
SVE USB & Storage Group

• Validated eMMC protocol on the ATOM SOC using decoding software on an oscilloscope that confirms proper timing and voltage levels of eMMC signals to and from the device.

• Developed, restructured, and maintained pre-silicon validation tests (C++) to meet full test coverage for various validation deadlines by identifying and debugging test or design issues.

• Analyzed RTL, waveforms, and test logs to root cause test failures and coordinated with component owners to discuss potential fixes or workarounds.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Qoalition:

• A community-focused platform that allows users to ask questions, provide answers, and award or upvote responses, with all of the data being stored in a hybrid server application utilizing both a SQL database and the Ethereum blockchain.

• Designed a SQL database using PostgreSQL to have relational application data securely stored and accessed while being ACID compliant with strict schemas, which also communicates via blockchain middleware APIs to store user’s questions and answers in the Ethereum blockchain.

• Developed smart contracts in Solidity that enabled the application server to communicate with the Ethereum blockchain to create, upvote, and downvote unique answers and questions, while also providing a decentralized voting mechanism that offer the community the ability to reward quality submissions.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Resourc.us:

• A community driven platform React application that allows users to share valuable resources, and commend their favorite to have the best stand out from the rest. Search by topics, or create and join teams to organize resources however you like.

• Designed a NoSQL database to handle user auth with JWTs and maintain user, team, and resource data provided by express route/controller RESTful APIs.

• Utilized React Router to create a clean and simple experience for users navigating the single page application by defining multiple routes and appropriate components for each view.

• Implemented elastic search to allow users to search for keywords pertaining to specific teams or resources to find what pertinent information quickly.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Created a client facing desktop application in Electron using React that allows developers to visualize the full Express server routing architecture and middleware flow to inspect the request/response lifecycle and provide a more efficient server debugging tool and environment.

• Designed an NPM package solution built on top of the pre-existing Express framework to capture pertinent server routing, middleware source code, and response data to the obServerJS application to monitor and analyze incoming server requests, middleware chaining, and outgoing server responses to provide transparent express routing for an improved server application development and debugging experience.

• Developed a test suite feature that allows users to input any number of predetermined server requests with expected responses and execute them to ensure proper responses from the server that allows developers to continuously develop and iterate on server applications and catch unexpected bugs early in development.

• Engineered a recursive algorithmic approach to parse through the Express application stack to generate a VisX tree graph that displays the entire express middleware and routing flows of servers which helps developers visualize the architecture of the entire server application to provide a convenient reference for routes and endpoints.

• Implemented a middleware execution sequence component by parsing the Express route stacks that visualizes the detailed middleware flow routing of incoming requests and their corresponding source code in order to show the specific lifecycle of any requests to help detect bugs and debug more efficiently.

• Product currently being developed under the tech-accelerator OS Labs (opensourcelabs.io)
